overlap.cpu_interval_scope: This observed interval precedes the earliest possible training call and demonstrates concurrent worker preparation, not optimizer work.
overlap.derivation: Both jobs are submitted after wave_start; worker pretraining_seconds is train_started - worker_started. Both training calls therefore lie inside [wave_start + min(pretraining_seconds), dispatch_end]. For two intervals, overlap >= sum(training_seconds) - length(enclosing interval).
overlap.scope: Overlap of complete training calls, including their model evaluation and optimizer work. No claim of simultaneous execution of optimizer inner-loop instructions. Exact phase timestamps were not recorded.
overlap.source_timing_definition: autoencoder_training_worker.py:1056,1338,1353,1413; worker_source_sha256 matches current file. native_stage.py:677-684 encloses submission, completion and pool close.
